note: Canonical de-duplicated set. Full per-lens detail (7 lenses, 40+ findings) in raw_lens_outputs. Severity per mandate §6.

findings.title: Review class mislabeled EXTERNAL_AUDIT across every authoritative surface
findings.requirement_violated: mandate §0 (no inherit EXTERNAL_AUDIT); honesty of measurement
findings.evidence: handoff:6, index:22/24/31/33, capsule.md:6/43, capsule.json:11, ADR_REGISTER:26, S5_REOPEN_STATUS:11/71 — 'EXTERNAL_AUDIT'/'auditoría externa'/'auditoría de ChatGPT'. The falsification and this reaudit were performed by Claude (AI), not a human/institutional auditor.
findings.failure_mode: A CEO or third party reads 'external audit complete/pending' and over-trusts an AI self-review as institutional sign-off.
findings.fix_now: Relabel forward-facing labels to AI_ASSISTED_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW; EXTERNAL_HUMAN_AUDIT=NOT_OBTAINED; retain historical state token with a gloss.
findings.definitive_fix: If an external human audit is arranged, record reviewer identity/scope/verdict and only then use EXTERNAL_AUDIT.
findings.closing_test: grep of R3 package for EXTERNAL_AUDIT returns only historical-state-token + gloss, no forward claim.
findings.residual_risk: Historical ADR state token still contains the word; glossed once authoritatively in the index.

findings.title: Entire R3 authority chain is UNTRACKED — not reproducible from the HEAD every header cites
findings.evidence: git status: all docs/engines/focus_v5/{ADR_FOCUS_TEMPORAL_QUALITY,CURRENT_AUTHORITY_INDEX,PROVENANCE_INCIDENT_V5_BUNDLE,S5_R3_*,S5_REOPEN_STATUS}.md + scripts/validate-authority-entrypoints.mjs are '??' (untracked). Headers say 'HEAD 8a06b9a' but a clean checkout of 8a06b9a contains none of them.
findings.failure_mode: External auditor checks out the cited HEAD, gets an empty package; provenance is not git-reproducible.
findings.fix_now: Disclose prominently (handoff §0, manifest) that the package is a WORKTREE package reproducible via byte-manifest, not checkout. Anchor = build_external_manifest.mjs.
findings.definitive_fix: CEO decision: commit the R3 package (currently forbidden by mandate) to give it real git provenance.
findings.closing_test: The package files appear in a committed tree whose SHA the manifest cites; or the manifest is accepted as the byte anchor.
findings.residual_risk: Until committed, integrity rests on worktree-byte manifest, not git.

findings.title: Falsified R2 gate is DESIGN-ONLY; prior 'code retirement PENDING' framing is misleading
findings.evidence: grep *.kt for monotonicGuard|mg-1|S_full|Sfull = 0 hits; no d'-recompute-under-exclusion; FocusTemporalEligibility.kt already implements R3 (E=g(excludedFraction), one-sided). Harness confirms flip is design-level.
findings.failure_mode: A reader believes a non-monotonic gate is live in production code needing removal, misdirecting Paso 4 effort.
findings.fix_now: Reframe MB-FOCUS-0047: pending = seal R2-SUPERSEDED in versioned ADR + guarantee wiring never reintroduces S_adm<=S_full. Not 'retire code'.
findings.definitive_fix: ADR register shows R2 SUPERSEDED; Paso 4 wiring PR contains no d'-recompute-under-exclusion; harness stays green.
findings.closing_test: Harness green + ADR register R2=SUPERSEDED + Paso 4 diff has no S_adm gate.
findings.residual_risk: Wiring could still reintroduce the design if not guarded.

findings.title: security 'APTO' has no primary record and is contradicted by its own privacy lens
findings.evidence: Prior handoff:76 'security APTO' while the same handoff §4 lists GAP-1/GAP-2. Privacy lens (L5-01/02/03): revocation not wired into focus2 write-ahead AND no regression test (siblings have one); cross-account collateral wipe pattern reintroduced.
findings.failure_mode: A security clearance is asserted over data-lifecycle gaps that would mis-handle a revoked/deleted subject's cognitive data.
findings.fix_now: Downgrade to DOCUMENTATION_SECURITY_REVIEW_ONLY; name GAP-1/GAP-2 as open.
findings.definitive_fix: Wire subject-revocation into focus2 stores with a regression test mirroring the sibling stores; fix cross-account wipe.
findings.closing_test: focus2 revocation regression test present + green; cross-account erase test proves no collateral wipe.
findings.residual_risk: GAPs live but contained by CONTRACT_INERT (unmounted).

findings.title: Screen reader announces the correct answer + congruency → accuracy is NOT modality-fair
findings.requirement_violated: FocusEvidenceStatePolicy KDoc 'accuracy is modality-fair (charter §14)'; measurement validity
findings.evidence: FocusTracerScreen.kt:135-138 contentDescription = 'El elemento central apunta a la {izquierda|derecha}' (the correct flanker response) + 'Los elementos que lo rodean son {iguales|distintos}' (the congruency manipulation).
findings.failure_mode: Under screen reader the flanker-conflict is voided and the answer is given: accuracy trivially 100%, measuring nothing. Comparing that to a norm invalidates it. The 'accuracy is modality-fair' invariant is false.
findings.fix_now: Do not describe the central element's direction; announce only the array structure (or a modality-specific stimulus that preserves the conflict).
findings.definitive_fix: Separate a11y modality/estimand/norms; a construct-preservation test that fails if the description encodes the answer.
findings.closing_test: Test asserting the trial contentDescription does not contain the correct response direction.
findings.residual_risk: Even fixed, sequential-presentation may change the construct (L7-02).

findings.title: R3 contract defines no session-level missingness/MNAR policy for the eligibility gate
findings.evidence: D-R3-01..04 remove a DIRECT d' dependence (good) but define no policy for MNAR of excludedFraction itself. Device jank, pause/interruption, epoch-loss, thermal, and accessibility modality are non-random w.r.t. person. F-L2-02.
findings.failure_mode: Excluding technically-invalid capture can still be missing-not-at-random → longitudinal/between-person comparison biased by device/fatigue/disability, presenting selection as signal.
findings.fix_now: Register that outcome-independence != absence of MNAR; add MNAR as an explicit open scientific precondition in the eligibility spec (done: reaudit spec §3).
findings.definitive_fix: Preregistered missingness policy: reasons + coverage visible, sensitivity/bounds, all-designed vs observed vs technically-valid, no hidden attrition.
findings.owning_phase: Paso 4 shadow sims + Paso 6 device matrix; psychometrician
findings.closing_test: A missingness sensitivity analysis + bounds per tracer before any longitudinal comparison is enabled.
findings.residual_risk: MNAR may be irreducible for some device/disability strata → separate norms.

findings.title: differentialExclusionDelta is an orphan constant (R2 within-session MNAR detector dropped)
findings.requirement_violated: no dead safety config that reads as a live control
findings.evidence: grep differentialExclusionDelta shared/ = 1 hit (its own declaration TemporalQualityThresholds.kt:25); zero consumers. R2 had a within-session differential-exclusion detector; R3 dropped it, leaving the threshold dead.
findings.failure_mode: A reviewer assumes differential-exclusion MNAR detection exists; it does not.
findings.fix_now: Either wire the differential-exclusion detector (part of the MNAR policy RA-06) or remove the dead constant with a note.
findings.definitive_fix: Part of the MNAR policy in RA-06.
findings.closing_test: Constant has a consumer with a test, or is removed.

findings.title: Wiring-precondition defects: seal metadata unpopulated, drain discards typed outcome, shared-namespace wipe pattern
findings.evidence: L3-01: FocusRunPlanner.prepare() (only prod seal caller) cannot populate probeCapability/clockDomain/inputPrecision/nominalHzBand → eligibility reads cells nothing fills. LENS4-02: pre-session drain discards prior write-ahead without consuming FocusWriteOutcome. LENS4-03/L5-03: mindboost_focus2 subject-prefixed keys in a blanket-cleared shared namespace (GAP-2).
findings.failure_mode: When wired, the temporal eligibility has no metadata to act on; write failures are swallowed; account switch can collateral-wipe.
findings.fix_now: Track under MB-FOCUS-0048 with per-item DECISION/IMPLEMENTATION/VALIDATION (ADR §R3-15).
findings.definitive_fix: Populate seal metadata; consume FocusWriteOutcome; per-subject namespace isolation with test.
findings.closing_test: seal populates all 4 fields; drain asserts outcome; cross-account erase test.

findings.title: single-instance-per-user not enforced silently corrupts the write-ahead safety net
findings.evidence: LENS4-01: MB-FOCUS-0035 declared-not-enforced; two concurrent sessions for one user share the write-ahead store and corrupt each other without detection.
findings.failure_mode: Write-ahead recovery — the integrity foundation — is silently corrupted by concurrent sessions.
findings.definitive_fix: Enforce single-instance-per-user + concurrency/replay tests before mount.
findings.closing_test: concurrency test proves second session is refused or isolated.

findings.title: Reliability paradox not applied to the retained d' (S_full); no reliability/SEM/test-retest gate; Kucina uncited
findings.evidence: EXERCISE_PORTFOLIO_V5.md retires DELTA scores citing Hedge 2018 but keeps d'; ADR plans cross-session reliable-change on S_full; grep focus2 for reliab|SEM|test-retest|Hedge = 0 hits in code; grep 'Kucina' = 0 hits repo-wide. Tracers are exactly Hedge's low-reliability tasks (flanker, vigilance).
findings.failure_mode: Longitudinal reliable-change on an unquantified-reliability d' presents practice/regression/noise as capacity change.
findings.fix_now: Forbid cross-session reliable-change on S_full until per-tracer test-retest ICC+SEM measured; cite Kucina 2023.
findings.definitive_fix: Measured reliability as a V-gate blocker before any longitudinal d' comparison.
findings.closing_test: No cross-session contrast derivable without a measured reliability coefficient.

findings.title: Truncated 16-hex digests + out-of-band ledger seal + package-closure conflict
findings.evidence: Prior handoff §3 used 16-hex sha with no bytes/EOL; ledger §0 hash delivered out-of-band; handoff §6 excluded the harness/scorer needed to reproduce.
findings.failure_mode: Package cannot be integrity-verified or reproduced by a third party.
findings.fix_now: Full-SHA-256 manifest (build_external_manifest.mjs) hashes every member incl. handoff + ledger; handoff §6 now includes the harness + reaudit evidence.
findings.definitive_fix: Same, plus commit for git provenance (RA-02).
findings.closing_test: manifest package_root_sha256 recomputes; every member sha256 present.

findings.title: Target population + minors UNDEFINED, acknowledged only in an EXCLUDED process doc
findings.evidence: Master plan recruitment 'adultos' is alpha-research scope only; S5_R4_PASO7_PLAN_REVIEWED.md marks population/DPIA/minors NO/parcial but that doc is on the EXCLUDE list of the audit package (handoff §6). No age-gate in the INCLUDED R3 artifacts.
findings.failure_mode: Audit blind-spot: reviewer sees no signal that population/minors is an open blocker for a cognitive-training product.
findings.fix_now: Surface population/minors = UNDEFINED/BLOCKER inside an INCLUDED artifact (blockers matrix — done).
findings.definitive_fix: CEO+product define target population + age-gate/minors policy before any S6 human exposure.
findings.closing_test: population/minors BLOCKER row in package; mount checklist includes age-gate.

findings.title: GATE_CATALOG_V5.md stale L9 'all gates DESIGNED_NOT_RUN' + self-declared sole gate authority remains discoverable
findings.requirement_violated: §3.1.9 (stale doc must not masquerade as current authority)
findings.evidence: GATE_CATALOG_V5.md L9 frontmatter (frozen snapshot 27849450) says all gates DESIGNED_NOT_RUN, contradicting ledger PASS states; the file self-declares sole gate authority. It is tracked/sealed (custody D) so cannot be edited.
findings.failure_mode: A future session reads GATE_CATALOG as current gate authority and under-states executed gates.
findings.fix_now: Index §4.2 dispositions it; scanner extended to assert GATE_CATALOG is quarantined (no CURRENT marker) and its live states are read via the index.
findings.definitive_fix: At real S5 close, re-seal the bundle with a faithful catalog snapshot.
findings.closing_test: scanner FAILs if GATE_CATALOG gains a CURRENT marker or the index drops its disposition.
findings.residual_risk: content of the frozen file unchanged (history preserved)
